normalization: enums.json is the stdout of extract-enums.js run on the published package: the enum values the metadata schema port copies, read from the compiled schemas, as two-space indented JSON with a trailing LF. No upstream file is imported.
update_instructions: In an empty directory outside the tree: npm install --no-save --ignore-scripts @dcl/schemas@<version>, and check the installed version and integrity against the production lockfile.
Update version, revision (npm view @dcl/schemas@<version> gitHead), tarball, integrity and the file hashes here.
Run cargo test -p catalyst-content metadata_schema; a changed enum fails the copied-enum test until the constants in metadata_schema.rs match.
